bugs_found: apply_fee does not reject negative amount, so a malicious negative amount can produce nonsensical payouts after min/max fee logic
fx_convert does not validate rate positivity or finiteness, allowing negative/zero/Infinity/NaN exchange rates and invalid converted money
transfer is not atomic: debit happens before credit, so a failing account_to.balance update can leave funds removed without receipt
transfer does not normalize/validate amount as Decimal/finite, allowing TypeError paths or mixed numeric behavior instead of controlled validation
compound_interest and loan_payment silently truncate fractional years/months/compounds_per_year via int(), causing undeclared behavior changes
all functions lack explicit non-finite Decimal validation, allowing Infinity/NaN to leak or raise inconsistent Decimal exceptions
